# Antigravity specifics
- AGENTS.md is the source of rules; this file only adds Antigravity behaviour.
- Hard-enforcement rules in AGENTS.md are additionally enforced by hooks in .agents/hooks.json. Do not bypass hooks. Never use --dangerously-skip-permissions.
- In /deliver runs, write the plan to .fediim/plans/<n>.md and review it via the plan-reviewer subagent (do not create Antigravity UI Implementation Plan or Task List artifacts); for ad-hoc interactive multi-file changes outside /deliver, follow the planning rules.
